# streamtime_helm_repository (Resource)

A Helm chart repository that packages can come from. Managing the catalog needs the catalog permission, normally held by the root organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_helm_repository" "charts" {
  name     = "example-charts"
  base_url = "https://charts.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) The repository address, for example https://charts.example.com.
- `name` (String) A name for the repository. It is also the ID you use to import it. Changing it creates a new repository.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the chart repository. Use it to import an existing one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the repository's name.
terraform import streamtime_helm_repository.charts example-charts
```
